name: Furniture and Decor
description: Three groups of mods cover non-Create building.

pages.title: Furniture and Decor
pages.text:
Three groups of mods cover non-Create building:

- **Handcrafted**: furniture.
- **Macaw's** mods: doors, roofs and windows.
- **Supplementaries**: many small useful blocks.

Create-flavoured decor is in [#](2E5AAC)[Create Decor](entry://home/create_decor)[#]().

pages.title: Handcrafted
pages.text: Tables, benches, couches, desks, drawers, shelves, counters, beds, sheets and cushions in many wood types. Plus trophies and pillar trims for the walls.

pages.title: Macaw's Roofs
pages.text: Many roof shapes: attic, top and lower base roofs per wood and material. A Roofing Hammer helps. Macaw's Doors and Windows follow the same pattern.

pages.title: Macaw's Windows
pages.text: Resizeable windows, plus a Window Hammer and Window Key. Macaw's Doors adds many door styles and a Garage Remote.

pages.title: Diagonal Fences
pages.text: A fence you place also joins a fence one block away across a corner, when the corner is clear and neither post already joins straight that way. Wood fences join wood fences; stone and metal fences join each other.

pages.title: Supplementaries
pages.text: Jars hold small things. Also flags, awnings, bunting, candle holders, goblets, book piles, soap and a Wrench. Browse the item list in [#](2E5AAC)[JEI](entry://start_here/tools)[#]().

Furniture here is mostly decor. For seats on moving [#](2E5AAC)[contraptions](entry://create_basics/contraptions)[#](), Create's own Seat works, and [#](2E5AAC)[Coasters](entry://transport/coasters)[#]() add coaster seats.\
\
Cafe-style decor ties into [#](2E5AAC)[Cozy Cafe](entry://food/cozy_cafe)[#]().\
\
Sneak and right-click a fence with an empty hand to turn its corner joins off, or back on. Fences in villages and other found buildings start without them.
